prompt: Reference is exact design master of Sun Warden. Generate four distinct FRONT VIEW walk key poses, 2x2 sheet 1536x1024 transparent background, generous margins each 768x512 cell. Entire spear and halo must fit each cell; figure + weapon about 440px tall. Tall bronze automaton with faceless polished oval head, slender rigid articulated limbs, ONE straight long spear-gnomon held upright in character RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT) in every pose. Spear stays beside body, constant length and grip, never behind torso. Back-mounted rigid halo has exactly FIVE round mirror panels: top, upper-left, lower-left, upper-right, lower-right. Ring stays rigid attached to back, does not spin or change panels. Matching original warm bronze, sun mirrors, detailed handpainted fantasy. 2 arms and 2 legs only. A top-left contact: screen-left boot steps forward toward viewer, screen-right boot trails; B top-right passing: screen-left boot supports, screen-right knee bends slightly boot lifted passing under hip; C bottom-left opposite contact screen-right boot forward, screen-left trails; D bottom-right passing screen-right supports, screen-left boot lifted. Free arm counter-swings mildly, weapon hand maintains upright carry. Full body frontal eye-level orthographic camera consistent across poses, same scale and same head/hip anchor. No running high knees, no stretching, no duplicate limbs, no weapon bends, no face, no extra mirror panels, no text, border, shadow, floor or particles.
